text:
maria: Heads-up — master SAST started spitting ~120 new findings on generated proto files after yesterday's infra RBAC change. Failing premerge. Anyone seen this?

devon: I noticed a spike during the last deploy window. Looks like pregen artifacts are now owned by build:svc; scanner is treating them as source. Could be file perms + scanner include patterns.

sasha: Can we quick patch by updating .sastignore for /proto/gen? That feels risky if we hide real issues.

maria: I want to avoid ignores. Also FYI KMS rotation happened yesterday — signer might've emitted different markers. Audit logs show build:svc fetching keystore at 04:12 UTC.

scan-bot: Automated alert: +120 findings added. Top rule: proto-serialization-unsafe (confidence: low). Context: many files flagged under proto/gen/*.go.

kevin: Triage plan: 1) reproduce the GH Actions job locally 2) ls -la artifacts 3) check KMS decrypt/audit logs 4) capture raw scanner output. Assigning devon as primary.

devon: On it. Quick grep shows some generated files missing the usual header: 'DO NOT EDIT - GENERATED'. Upstream generator might've bumped and changed templates.

maria: If generator changed, pin it in CI and add a linter for the generated header. For this sprint can we add a pre-scan filter in CI instead of permanent ignores?

sasha: Also a note for infra: can we expand audit events to include artifact:decrypt or keystore:ephemeral-grant? Right now we only log keystore:get which makes timing windows hard to debug.

devon: Diving into logs — KMS logs show a 403 at 04:10 for build:svc, then a success at 04:11 after ephemeral grant. That timing window aligns with the build that produced the flagged artifacts. Seems like an RBAC timing race during rotation.

maria: OK. Plan of record: devon opens PR with CI pre-scan filter + repro steps + evidence bundle; sasha files infra ticket to expand keystore audit events; kevin will coordinate a temporary suppression policy for CI to avoid blocking merges (not permanent). I'll keep the thread updated. @oncall for visibility.

kevin: :thumbsup: Please add a blurb to the postmortem template about RBAC timing causing scan noise so we don't forget mitigations.

devon: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/987 — includes reproducer and a temporary scanner --exclude-paths patch for proto/gen and .build. CI run attached logs: 
```
scanner --root . --rules proto-serialization-unsafe
found: file proto/gen/api_v2.pb.go: line 12 missing generated header
```

sasha: Filed infra ticket INFRA-2143 to expand keystore audit events. Owner: sasha, approver: infra-oncall.

scan-bot: Update: CI run with temporary suppression passed; 0 new failures. Reminder: suppression must be reverted after root cause is fixed.

maria: Thanks all. We'll keep this open until infra audit tweak is live and the generator is pinned in CI. Leaving assignment: devon -> follow up PR to pin generator + add linter; sasha -> follow infra ticket; kevin -> suppression rollback checklist.

oncall: Acknowledged. Adding this to the oncall handoff notes for tonight.

maria: Closing loop soon — will post the postmortem link here once we draft it.
